work.rail.label: Sessions
work.rail.menu.label: more for {{title}}
work.rail.search.label: search sessions
work.rail.search.placeholder: search by name or by what was said
work.rail.search.cut: More matched than is shown here — add a word to narrow it.
work.rail.onTip: this session runs on another machine — its record travelled here, its process did not
work.rail.treeTip: this session holds a working tree of its own rather than the repository's registered checkout, so the two do not collide.
work.rail.landedTip: this session's work landed on that branch, and its review reads the work there.
work.rail.landedGoneTip: this session's work landed on that branch, which is gone now. Its review says whether the work reads on the line.
work.rail.elapsedTip: how long this session has been going — not when it last moved
work.rail.parkedTip: Its quest parked after too many failed sessions here, and waits for you: its page says why, and Try again, in this row’s ⋯ or on that page, starts it again.
work.rail.heldHere: held here until you try again
work.rail.heldTip: You stopped this session, so its quest waits on this machine: nothing starts it here until you choose Try again, in this row’s ⋯ or on the quest’s page.
work.rail.awaitsTip: Its quest asked another repository a question, and carries on by itself when the answer comes.
work.rail.reviewTip: Its own tree holds work no branch of yours holds yet. Review it to land it, send it back or discard it.
work.rail.archivedTip: Archived on this machine: kept whole, and out of the list unless Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, is ticked.
work.rail.empty.headline: Nothing is running
work.rail.empty.body: Sessions appear here as the driver takes quests and as you open conversations, listed by what each one needs from you.
work.rail.pausedTip: Its quest is paused on this machine: nothing of its work starts here until you resume it, and Resume carries it on.
